question: which stopping test ends each arm, where the cold and seeded fits first diverge, and the per-evaluation saving at identical work

diagnosis.method: local uncommitted logging build (diagnosis/trace-patch.py): EPCSAFT_FIT_TRACE logs every evaluation (point, weighted residuals, Jacobian) and every Ceres or Ipopt iteration; EPCSAFT_COLD_FIT=1 offers no previous density
diagnosis.controls: F2 1e-15, 1e-14, 1e-14 (round-2/3 script controls); B4 declared Ipopt tolerance 1e-10
diagnosis.reproduced: the traced endpoints and work counts equal round3/endpoints.csv exactly

probes: stop-probes.csv: both arms on the traced wheel, the same FitControls (F2) or MinimaxRequest tolerance (B4) for both arms; Engine defaults unchanged

timing.procedure: seven counterbalanced pairs per control set, complete fit call, one worker per wheel (round-2 procedure)
timing.B4: declared Ipopt tolerance 1e-10 in every set
timing.script_controls_endpoints: identical byte for byte to round3/endpoints.csv on the round-4 wheels; retained once there

evidence_type: numerical verification and performance measurement; no physical validation

cold.source: seeded source with previous-trial density offers omitted in fit.cpp (round-3 method)
